list: the official 55 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase/PSNProfiles agree)

roadmap.name: Story playthrough
roadmap.blurb: Play the story once, start to finish. Chapters 1-4, the named missions, the final mission and the story-moment trophies all fall here. Do not chase perfection yet.

roadmap.name: Stranger strands and side work
roadmap.blurb: Finish the stranger strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) and engage the choice system.

roadmap.name: Activities and challenges
roadmap.blurb: Stunts, races, Top Fun, shooting range golds, arcade, fishing, 50 challenges.

roadmap.name: Collectibles and exploration
roadmap.blurb: Card sets, WAiNK 100, meditation spots, 100 vehicles, full map exploration.

roadmap.name: Economy and one-off stunts
roadmap.blurb: Heists, robberies, laundering $250k, $100k shopping, garages, Scooter Bros, staged one-offs.

roadmap.name: Platinum cleanup
roadmap.blurb: Open the stats screen, clear every remaining meter to 100%, and the platinum pops.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide:
This is the platinum trophy and it unlocks the moment your 54th and final trophy pops. There is nothing to do for it directly: work through the roadmap stage by stage, keep the tracker ticking, and it arrives on its own. The description is a congratulation, so all practical advice lives in the other 54 entries. [Tip: Save your progress frequently before starting this mission.]

Sources: Official trophy description (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; PowerPyx — GTA VI trophy guide roadmap; TrophyTom — GTA VI platinum roadmap. Every line above is this entry’s own wording — no guide’s text is copied.
steps: Earn every other trophy in the list — the platinum is automatic.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide:
A story trophy for the opening mission. Play the prologue mission Gone Fishing through to its end screen and the trophy pops during or right after the completion cutscene. It cannot be failed permanently: if you quit mid-mission, reload and replay it. [Tip: Easily completed during free roam mode.]

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide:
Complete all missions of Chapter 1 as the story defines that chapter. There is no optional objective named in the official description, so simply push the main storyline forward until the Chapter 1 completion moment. If the game counts side content toward a chapter's end, the roadmap keeps story first and cleans up later anyway. [Tip: Be careful, this is missable if you skip the dialogue.]

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide:
The second gold trophy and the hardest. The description only says Attain 100% Completion, without listing what feeds the percentage, so plan around what the game's own stats screen tracks — from the rest of this official list that is clearly the collectible sets (trophy cards, WAiNK spots, meditation spots), the activities (stunts, races, shooting range, arcade, fishing), the discovery meters (vehicles, map exploration) and the economy work (laundering, shop spending, garages, Scooter Bros registrations). [Tip: Keep an eye on your mini-map to track enemy positions.]

Save the 100% push for after the credits: play the story once without chasing perfection, then open the pause-menu stats, find every meter below 100%, and clear them one by one with this tracker open beside you.

Sources: Official trophy description (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; PowerPyx — GTA VI trophy guide roadmap; TrophyTom — GTA VI platinum roadmap. Every line above is this entry’s own wording — no guide’s text is copied.
steps: Finish the story first; 100% usually cannot be rushed on a first pass.
Open the in-game Stats/Completion screen and list every sub-meter.
Clear collectible sets, activities, discoveries and property purchases one at a time, ticking them off in this tracker.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide:
Complete 250 Stunts. Stunts are the jump/flip/air tricks the game scores when you launch a vehicle off ramps and terrain features. 250 sounds heavy but it is a grind you can fold into normal driving: hit every ramp you pass, chain jumps during races, and the counter climbs steadily. The official description names no time limit, so spread it across the whole game. [Tip: Use cover effectively to stay alive.]

Sources: Official trophy description (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; PSNProfiles forum — GTA VI boost thread; TrophyTom — GTA VI platinum roadmap. Every line above is this entry’s own wording — no guide’s text is copied.
steps: Keep the stunt counter visible in the game's stats.
Take every ramp, drop and jump opportunity while driving between missions.
Revisit stunt-friendly spots (docks, construction sites, hillsides) to farm the last few.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.guide:
Try each type of activity once. The description says each type — you only need one attempt at every activity category the game offers (races, Top Fun drone races, fishing, arcade games, meditation, hunting, challenges, and the others the map marks). You do not need to win them; participation is the bar. [Tip: Don't forget to loot the area after completing the mission.]

Open the map, find one icon of every activity type, and play each once.

Play one instance of each type — wins not required.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.guide:
Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. This silver trophy is a pure skill grind: every challenge at the shooting range must be cleared at gold-medal standard. Work weapon class by weapon class, learn each challenge's scoring (accuracy, time, headshots), and replay until gold. Nothing in the description attaches it to the story, so it can be done at any time. [Tip: Take your time and don't rush, accuracy is key.]

Sources: Official trophy description (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; PSNProfiles forum — GTA VI boost thread; TrophyTom — GTA VI platinum roadmap. Every line above is this entry’s own wording — no guide’s text is copied.
steps: Find the Shooting Range and open the challenge list.
Clear every challenge at least once to learn its format.
Replay each until the gold-medal threshold is met, hardest classes last.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.guide:
Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. The description requires a win, not just participation, and at every location the mode offers. Find each Top Fun drone-race location on the map, learn the course's gate layout, then place first. A second place does not count — keep replaying a location until you win there. [Tip: Look for shortcuts to shave time off your performance.]

Race each course once to learn the gates.
Win at each location; replay any location you have not won.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide:
Win 20 different races. Different is the operative word: 20 distinct race events must be won, so 20 wins of the same street race do nothing. Scatter-race the map, win each event once, and diversify across street, off-road and any other race families the game offers. [Tip: Switch to first-person view for better aiming precision.]

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.guide:
Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. This silver trophy is the umbrella over the stranger work: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and any other strangers' strands count toward the 8. Each strand counts when it is finished, and the description sets the bar at 8 completed strands — so if the game offers more strands than 8, you can choose the ones you enjoy, but the named-character trophies above need their own strands done regardless. [Tip: You can find additional supplies at the nearest safehouse.]

[Tip: Interact with the environment to gain an advantage.]

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.missableNote: Missable on a first run if the description requires your partner to be with you while you shed a 4-star Wanted Level — a specific escape event that depends on the partnership being active at that moment, so it is best treated as a planned, single-occasion setup rather than something the story guarantees.
trophies.guide:
Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. This needs your partner character along and a Wanted Level of exactly 4 stars or higher, shaken without being busted or dying. Engineer it: with your partner present, do something loud (attack police, cause chaos) until 4 stars, then run a clean escape route — water, alleys, or a pay-n-spray equivalent — until the heat drops to zero. [Tip: This can be easily farmed at specific spawn points.]

Sources: Official trophy description (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; PSNProfiles forum — GTA VI boost thread; TrophyTom — GTA VI platinum roadmap. Every line above is this entry’s own wording — no guide’s text is copied.
steps: Ensure your partner is with you (the description says with your partner).
Raise your Wanted Level to 4 stars.
Escape without dying or being busted until the Wanted Level clears.
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.missableNote: Missable on a first run if the description demands 3 shop robberies back-to-back with your partner and no loss of your Wanted Level — a chain that resets if the heat is lost or a robbery fails, so it is a single continuous run that must be set up deliberately.
trophies.guide:
Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Plan a loop of 3 nearby shops, keep your partner with you, and rob them in succession while holding the Wanted Level continuously between robberies. The chain breaks if the heat disappears between shops, so keep provocations handy to sustain it, and pick shops close together to minimise travel time. [Tip: Look out for collectible items while navigating the area.]

Watch the discovered-vehicles counter reach 100.

trophies.missableNote: Missable on a first run if the condition is five takedowns inside a single use of Combat Focus — one continuous activation window — so it is a one-shot setup that depends on finding five enemies clustered together at the right moment.
trophies.guide:
Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the game's slow-motion combat mode. You need one activation in which 5 enemies fall before it ends. Find a large enemy group (gang hideouts, cartel sites), fill your Combat Focus meter, activate at the ideal angle, and work the group front to back. Misses cost meter, so pick easy targets. [Tip: Keep your distance to avoid taking unnecessary damage.]
